race.description: 2026 Trackside Pet Meats Spring Classic Special Ev
race.comment: BLIZZARD BYRNE (1) jumped well from this draw last time and was prominent throughout before moving up to score (29.51) at this track over 512m in a Special conditions race. Has the ability and looks a key chance again. FULL BORE DONNY (2) flew the lids with a fast early split last time, hitting the frame with a 1.3 lengths second (29.60) over 512m at this track and making it two placings on end. Remains without a win from the draw but has been in the placings two times from three attempts. Must be included in calculations. WILLALOOKA FURY (4) jumped cleanly from the rails last start to lead all the way and score (29.41) at this track in a Special conditions race over 512m. Recorded one of the quickest times on the card in scoring last start. Expected to feature again. WILL JENKINS (5) is not to be discarded.
